documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Meeting To Be Held On Tuesday, November 03, 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Shanti Gold International Limited reported its Q1 FY27 earnings, highlighting a strong revenue and profit growth driven by volume expansion and the commencement of operations at its new Marol manufacturing facility. Management maintained its full-year guidance for 50% to 60% value growth and 30% to 40% volume growth, alongside an estimated top line of INR3,500 crores. The company is also progressing with its upcoming Jaipur facility and a rights issue of up to INR100 crores to support its growth plans. Sustainable EBITDA margins are expected to be around 7.5% to 8% for the rest of the year. Shanti Gold International Limited released its investor presentation for Q1 FY27, reporting strong financial growth with revenues from operations reaching ₹716.4 Cr and PAT at ₹50.5 Cr.

guidance.claim: Management sticks to its guidance of INR3,500 crores for the current year.
guidance.quote: See, basically, the guidance as of now, we are sticking to the guidance of INR3,500 crores.

guidance.claim: The company expects around 30% to 40% growth in terms of volume and around 60% to 70% growth in terms of value for the coming year.
guidance.quote: So this year, i.e current coming year, it will be around 30% to 40% growth in terms of volume and around 60%-70% growth in terms of value

guidance.claim: Management stated that the sustainable net profit margin would be around 4% plus.
guidance.quote: This margin would be around 4% and all, which we've been maintaining that 4% plus and all.

guidance.claim: Export contribution is expected to increase from 10% to 20% or more.
guidance.quote: So I told you like this year will be like from 5% to we are going to go up to 10% or maybe more. Sorry, from 10% to 20%.

demand_outlook.claim: The outlook for organized jewellery continues to remain constructive, supported by strong wedding and occasion-led demand.
demand_outlook.quote: From an industry perspective, the outlook for the organized jewellery continues to remain constructive. India's jewellery market is supported by strong wedding and occasion-led demand, rising disposable incomes, and an increasable preference for organized and branded jewellery.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains very bullish on the long-term fundamentals of gold.
demand_outlook.quote: So the long-term, our vision towards the gold is very, very bullish. The long-term fundamentals remain very strong.

demand_outlook.claim: Despite elevated gold prices, overall demand trends remained resilient across key markets and customer segments, particularly in wedding and occasions-led jewellery categories.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite elevated gold prices during the year, overall demand trends remained resilient across key markets and customer segments. We continue to witness healthy transactions, particularly in wedding and occasions-led jewellery categories.

demand_outlook.claim: The company continues to receive sustained inquiries and repeat purchases from customers.
demand_outlook.quote: Encouragingly, we continue to receive sustained inquiries and repeat purchases from our customers, which provide us with confidence and visibility regarding future business momentum.

demand_outlook.claim: Increased outsourcing preference among organized jewellers and retailers is being witnessed as they focus on footprints, inventory optimization, and faster design cycles.
demand_outlook.quote: One of the most encouraging trends we are witnessing today is the increasing outsourcing preference among organized jewellers, retailers, as retailers continue to focus on expanding their footprint, inventory optimizing, and faster design cycles.

demand_outlook.claim: India remains one of the world's largest consumers of gold jewellery, supported by cultural affinity, rising disposable incomes, wedding demands, and branded jewellery preference.
demand_outlook.quote: India remains one of the world's largest consumers of gold jewellery, strongly supported by strong cultural affinity, rising disposable incomes, wedding demands, and increasing preference for branded jewellery at the same time.

capex_expansion.claim: Operations have successfully commenced at the new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai.
capex_expansion.quote: Coming to the quarter, Q1 FY27 was an important period for the company, particularly from an operational perspective, with the successful commencement of operations at our new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai.

capex_expansion.claim: The upcoming Jaipur facility will further strengthen the company's manufacturing footprint.
capex_expansion.quote: Alongside this, the upcoming Jaipur facility will further strengthen our manufacturing footprint and support our ability to address the growing demand across markets.

capex_expansion.claim: The capex allotted for the Jaipur facility is around INR47 crores, and it should be operational around mid-November or December.
capex_expansion.quote: So capex is around INR47 crores what we have allotted for Jaipur facility, and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on.

capex_expansion.claim: The Jaipur factory is spread across 3 acres of land, with the first phase covering 50,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: Jaipur factory is actually spread across 3 acres of land, and this 50,000 is just one segment of those, of the whole plant that we have.

capex_expansion.claim: The existing Andheri manufacturing facility has an installed capacity of approximately 2,700 kilo per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: Our existing Andheri manufacturing facility with an installed capacity of approximately 2,700 kilo per annum has been operating at healthy utilization levels in line with the growth of our new Marol facility in Mumbai, which will add approximately 4,000 kilo per annum of manufacturing capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: The 1,200 kilo per annum capacity addition announced during the IPO at Jaipur continues to progress in line with expectations.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition, the 1,200 kilo per annum capacity addition announced during an IPO at Jaipur, continues to progress in line with expectations.

capex_expansion.claim: Capacity additions will take the total installed manufacturing capacity to nearly 7,900 kilogram per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: Once operational, this addition will take our total installed manufacturing capacity to nearly 7,900 kilogram per annum, positioning us strongly for the next phase of scalable growth.

capex_expansion.claim: The Marol factory is expected to start in a month or so, and the Jaipur factory should start around September or October.
capex_expansion.quote: So see, our new factory is almost ready, which is going to be like in a month or so for Marol factory, and I guess Jaipur factory should be starting by around September, October now.

margins_costs.claim: Roughly 2% to 2.5% of the quarter's EBITDA margin comprised unrealized gain from inventory method change.
margins_costs.quote: So roughly 2% to 2.5% was the inventory gain. So if you remove that percent, roughly going forward, looking at the current demand and all, we should be in the range of 7.5% to 8% EBITDA.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 gross margin was reported at 10.9%.
Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin stood at 10.0%.
Q4 FY26 EBITDA margins stood at 10.17% compared to 7.10% in the corresponding period last year, improving by 306 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins for the quarter stood at 10.17% as compared to 7.10% in the corresponding period last year, improving by 306 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: FY26 EBITDA margins stood at 9.86% compared to 8.13% in FY25, improving by 173 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins for FY26 stood at 9.86% as compared to 8.13% in FY25, improving by 173 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margins for Q4 FY26 stood at 7.88% as against 3.09% in Q4 FY25.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margins for the quarter stood at 7.88% as against 3.09% in Q4 FY25.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margins for FY26 stood at 6.94% compared to 4.89% in FY25, improving by 205 basis points Y-o-Y.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margins for FY26 stood at 6.94% as compared to 4.89% in FY25, improving by 205 basis pointsY-o-Y.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization for the Mumbai existing facility is 75%.
The total installed capacity on completion is 7,900 kg per annum.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has approved a rights issue of 46,43,471 fully paid-up equity shares aggregating up to INR100 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As part of our growth and capital planning, the company has approved a rights issue of 46,43,471 fully paid-up equity shares of face value 10 each, aggregating up to INR100 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Post the rights issue, the total number of shares should be around INR7.67 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: The right issue is 46,43,471 and post rights issue it should be around INR7.67 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The current debt-to-equity ratio of the company is 0.50.
capital_allocation.quote: See, debt-to-equity, madam, currently we are at 0.50, which is still – we plan to go up to less than one maybe because still, as I told you, we are on a growth spree.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a disciplined approach towards working capital management, operational efficiency, and balance sheet strength.
capital_allocation.quote: The company continues to maintain a disciplined approach towards working capital management, operational efficiency, and balance sheet strength while continuing to invest in future growth opportunities.

risks_headwinds.claim: The incorporation timeline for the Dubai subsidiary has been extended to June '26 due to geopolitical issues and wars.
risks_headwinds.quote: So due to all these wars and all, it is extended for a couple of months more ahead now because the situation, geopolitical things are not good.

management_commitments.quote: So see, our new factory is almost ready, which is going to be like in a month or so for Marol factory, and I guess Jaipur factory should be starting by around September, October now.

management_commitments.quote: So this year, i.e current coming year, it will be around 30% to 40% growth in terms of volume and around 60%-70% growth in terms of value
